gloss: to pass; to overtake; to outstrip

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {追|お}い{抜|ぬ}きませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {追|お}い{抜|ぬ}いていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {追|お}い{抜|ぬ}いていませんでした

definitions.explanation: To catch up with and move ahead of someone or something that was in front. Used for physical movement like running or driving.
To exceed someone in performance, ranking, or achievement. Used figuratively for competition, statistics, or progress.

examples.english: I passed the car in front.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦{手前|てまえ}→手前：01001_temae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追|お}い{抜|ぬ}いた。
examples.english: I overtook three people all at once just before the finish line.

notes:
Godan verb (⟦{五段|ごだん}→五段：28275_godan⟧). Transitive — takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the person or thing being overtaken.

ASPECT (ている):
- {追|お}い{抜|ぬ}いた (completed the overtaking)
- {追|お}い{抜|ぬ}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (has overtaken; is in a state of having passed)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{追|お}い{越|こ}す→追い越す：04623_oikosu⟧ means the same but is slightly more common in everyday speech
- {追|お}い{抜|ぬ}く emphasizes fully passing and leaving behind, while ⟦{追|お}い{越|こ}す→追い越す：04623_oikosu⟧ can suggest just moving ahead momentarily

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追|お}い{抜|ぬ}く (to pass a car)
- ⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}い{抜|ぬ}く (to overtake in one burst)
- ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{追|お}い{抜|ぬ}く (to surpass in sales)
